topic: Mihawk's undefeated record and his Marineford walk-away are evidence he secretly has Conqueror's (Supreme King) Haki
title: Mihawk Never Lost. That Isn't Just Skill
description: Mihawk has never lost a sword fight, and he walked away from Marineford as calmly as Blackbeard did. Here's why I think that's Supreme King Haki, not just swordsmanship. Confirmed, or just the longest telegraph in the story?
comment: Does Mihawk secretly have Conqueror's Haki, or is World's Strongest Swordsman pure blade skill? Pick a side.

lines.text: Mihawk has never lost a sword fight in this entire story.
I don't think that's just skill. I think it's Supreme King Haki.

shot.fallback: swordsman radiating a hidden, commanding presence

lines.text: At Marineford, Blackbeard backs off from Shanks without one single blow.

shot.fallback: dark pirate captain withdrawing from a confrontation

lines.text: Mihawk does the exact same thing, same breath, same calm.

shot.fallback: hawk-eyed swordsman calmly leaving a battlefield

lines.text: Pure skill doesn't walk through that kind of danger unshaken.

shot.fallback: swordsman unbothered by overwhelming forces nearby

lines.text: Then in chapter 1194, Mihawk teaches Zoro something stranger than swordsmanship.

shot.fallback: hawk-eyed swordsman teaching a kneeling student

lines.text: He teaches him how willpower itself holds steady under pressure.

shot.fallback: swordsman imparting a lesson about inner resolve

lines.text: That's not a sword lesson. That's how Conqueror's Haki actually works.

shot.fallback: swordsman channeling a commanding, unshakable will

lines.text: No databook has ever confirmed this. I know that.
But an undefeated record, a calm walk from war, and this exact lesson stop looking like coincidence.

shot.fallback: three threads weaving into one conclusion

lines.text: So maybe Mihawk never agreed to oppose anyone, for one simple reason...

shot.fallback: swordsman standing entirely on his own terms

lines.text: Which is exactly why I don't think it was ever just a sword fight to begin with...

shot.fallback: swordsman standing undefeated at the edge of a cliff

self_check.hook: claim in line 1, names Mihawk immediately
self_check.loop: last line leads back into reconsidering line 1's claim rather than repeating it verbatim
